_comment: Every request the 2026-10-06 UTC ministry probe made, in order (2026-10-06
in Ha Noi; 2026-10-06 in the owner's US time zone). One worker, a fresh
requests session per request, no cookie ever sent, no redirect followed,
Accept-Encoding: identity, raw bytes read with decode_content=False, at
least 2 s from the end of one request to the start of the next, enforced
through a lock file. robots.txt first on every host; no URL guessed.
Committed exact fixtures (*.bin) are byte-identical to the wire. Derived
fixtures (derived-*) are NOT source bytes: each names what was replaced and
the original SHA-256 it came from, which stays in the row's sha256. Every
other capture is recorded by its SHA-256 only. Server-assigned cookie values
(including a bearer token moit.gov.vn sets, and the challenge cookie
bqp.vn's script sets) are redacted; nothing else is. seq 1 is a record the
probe harness failed to write: only its bytes survive.

transport: requests 2.32.5; fresh session per request; no cookies sent; no automatic redirects; raw bytes, decode_content=False

www.mof.gov.vn.verdict: no basis under repository rule: robots.txt answered with something other than a plain-text rules file; not a refusal

decisions.rule: a 200 body is a rules file when it is UTF-8, holds no markup, every line is a known directive (user-agent, allow, disallow, crawl-delay, sitemap, host) and at least one User-agent line exists; a Content-Type other than text/plain is recorded as an anomaly
